plain: The theory hits the measured atmospheric neutrino mass gap to 3.5%, but only through a chain of choices the axioms do not make. This attack shows that, at the repo's own 5% gate, the hit needs just two bridges (heavy scale = geometric mean of the Planck and weak scales; Dirac coupling = g^2/64) plus two unstated conventions (g read at the Z mass; unreduced Planck mass). The other bridges are idle or smaller than the gate, and the hit is weak evidence: formula-count bounds run from 1.5% to 89%, and the repo's own history shows the formula was chosen against the target.
best_route: R1: restate the claim as the midpoint form m3 = y^2 v^(3/2) M_Pl^(-1/2) with y = g^2/64 (drops the plaquette value, eps/B, k_A and the 7/8 factor; removes the T31 coupling), then pay for the log-midpoint reading and g^2/64 separately.
test: Pre-registered script: chain reproduces +3.52%; the midpoint form (measured v, no alpha_LM) gives -1.8%; g read above 324 GeV, a reduced Planck mass, or an unquenched plaquette (T31 shifts, chain form) each destroy the hit (-12% to -96%); 81 documented variants have coverage 30%, 72 natural coupling forms x 15 rungs have coverage 89% (36% for g^a/2^b only).
price: Log-midpoint reading of the endpoint-exchange lift (M_1 = sqrt(M_Pl v)), y = g(M_Z)^2/64 (ADM-1..3 with g at M_Z), and the unreduced Planck mass 1.2209e19 GeV; equivalence checked to 5% (not an identity), with k_A, eps/B and the (7/8)^(1/4) factor idle or below the gate.
